offering_description.value: TXNM Energy generates and purchases electricity and sells it to households, businesses, and public institutions in New Mexico through its own grid. In Texas, it operates transmission and distribution lines that deliver electricity to customers served by retail electricity providers.

customer_segment.value: B2C: Residential electricity customers; B2B: Commercial and industrial electricity users, private institutions, and Texas retail electricity providers; B2G: Government agencies and public institutions that buy electricity

end_markets.value: residential electricity; commercial electricity; industrial electricity; public-sector electricity; retail power supply

revenue_model.value: product sales: Electricity sold at regulated rates in New Mexico; transaction or usage fees: Regulated transmission and distribution charges based on usage, demand, or customer class
revenue_model.category: product sales; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Operates generating plants and power grids to supply retail customers and deliver power for Texas retailers; retailer: Sells electricity from company generation and purchased power to New Mexico customers

geography_served.value: US regional: New Mexico and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: Electricity generation, retail supply, transmission, and distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Direct utility service and billing for New Mexico electricity customers; partners / resellers: Texas retail electricity providers that bill customers for power delivered over the utility's network

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Utility rates and grid operations regulated by the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission, Public Utility Commission of Texas, and FERC
